mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as the economy faces a demand shock.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month and 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year growth rate of industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 0.5%, the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced corporate output and earnings, leading to negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth rate < 0.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate hiring supports earnings growth.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth positive and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually signals an overheating economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as the Fed is expected to tighten policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a broad economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as the risk of recession increases.
failure_condition: Both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline from prior period and 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to higher discount rates, leading to negative returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.
